description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2096/17 of  05.11.2018 (Duties & Functions)
categorisation: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and outlines specific portfolio responsibilities being amended (Government printing and publications, Department of Government Printing).
